recommendations.IT: Enforce a password policy with a minimum of 12 characters.
recommendations.Legal: Legal should ensure compliance for 'Password Length' is reflected in contracts and regulatory documents.
recommendations.Compliance: Compliance team should verify 'Password Length' control implementation and maintain evidence for audits.

recommendations.IT: Enable MFA across all accounts.
recommendations.Legal: Legal should ensure compliance for 'Mfa Enabled' is reflected in contracts and regulatory documents.
recommendations.Compliance: Compliance team should verify 'Mfa Enabled' control implementation and maintain evidence for audits.

data_encryption.recommendation: Encrypt data at rest and in transit.

recommendations.IT: Encrypt data at rest and in transit.
recommendations.Legal: Legal should ensure compliance for 'Data Encryption' is reflected in contracts and regulatory documents.
recommendations.Compliance: Compliance team should verify 'Data Encryption' control implementation and maintain evidence for audits.

account_lockout_threshold.recommendation: Lock accounts after 5 failed login attempts.

recommendations.IT: Lock accounts after 5 failed login attempts.
recommendations.Legal: Legal should ensure compliance for 'Account Lockout Threshold' is reflected in contracts and regulatory documents.
recommendations.Compliance: Compliance team should verify 'Account Lockout Threshold' control implementation and maintain evidence for audits.

log_retention_period_days.recommendation: Retain security logs for at least 1 year.

recommendations.IT: Retain security logs for at least 1 year.
recommendations.Legal: Legal should ensure compliance for 'Log Retention Period Days' is reflected in contracts and regulatory documents.
recommendations.Compliance: Compliance team should verify 'Log Retention Period Days' control implementation and maintain evidence for audits.

recommendations.IT: Ensure automated weekly backups are configured and monitored.
recommendations.Legal: Review data backup SLAs with third-party vendors and ensure they meet compliance standards.
recommendations.Compliance: Verify documented procedures for backup frequency and test restoration regularly.

recommendations.IT: Deploy and configure Data Loss Prevention tools across endpoints and networks.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure vendor contracts include DLP measures for third-party data handling.
recommendations.Compliance: Audit and validate the operational effectiveness of DLP policies.

recommendations.IT: Coordinate with HR to conduct and track mandatory cybersecurity training.
recommendations.Legal: Review training content for regulatory language and contractual obligations.
recommendations.Compliance: Maintain evidence of completed trainings and monitor training frequency.

recommendations.IT: Ensure all stored credit card data is encrypted using PCI-DSS compliant algorithms.
recommendations.Legal: Review merchant and payment processor agreements for encryption clauses.
recommendations.Compliance: Conduct regular audits of credit card storage and encryption policies.

recommendations.IT: Automate access review reports and flag anomalies for review.
recommendations.Legal: Validate employee access policies in relation to contracts and liability.
recommendations.Compliance: Document access reviews and ensure they are conducted on schedule.

session_timeout_minutes.recommendation: Session timeout after 15 minutes of inactivity.

recommendations.IT: Configure session timeout policies in applications and infrastructure.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure session timeout policies align with user privacy agreements.
recommendations.Compliance: Include session timeout controls in regular security audits.

incident_response_plan_tested.recommendation: Test the incident response plan annually.

recommendations.IT: Run tabletop and live incident response simulations annually.
recommendations.Legal: Review notification obligations in contracts and regulations.
recommendations.Compliance: Document IR testing results and track improvement actions.

recommendations.IT: Evaluate third-party security posture using questionnaires or tools.
recommendations.Legal: Review and update Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).
recommendations.Compliance: Maintain vendor risk assessments and mitigation logs.

vulnerability_scan_frequency_days.recommendation: Perform vulnerability scans at least quarterly.

recommendations.IT: Schedule regular automated scans and patch vulnerabilities.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure security clauses in contracts cover vulnerability remediation.
recommendations.Compliance: Include scan results in compliance reports and audits.

recommendations.IT: Hire certified testers or internal red teams to conduct tests.
recommendations.Legal: Include breach liability clauses based on pentest results.
recommendations.Compliance: Retain testing results and track remediation.

data_subject_request_response_days.recommendation: Respond to data subject access requests within 30 days.

recommendations.IT: Establish systems to locate and retrieve subject data efficiently.
recommendations.Legal: Review legal deadlines and documentation required for DSARs.
recommendations.Compliance: Track DSAR requests and ensure timely closure.

data_retention_policy_defined.recommendation: Define and enforce a data retention policy.

recommendations.IT: Ensure systems enforce data deletion schedules.
recommendations.Legal: Review retention limits by jurisdiction and industry.
recommendations.Compliance: Publish and review data retention policies regularly.

recommendations.IT: Ensure recovery infrastructure is tested and operational.
recommendations.Legal: Verify continuity plans are covered in key client agreements.
recommendations.Compliance: Maintain documented business continuity test results.

recommendations.IT: Conduct full failover tests annually and resolve gaps.
recommendations.Legal: Confirm contractual DR obligations with vendors and clients.
recommendations.Compliance: Include DR test reports in compliance documentation.

portable_device_encryption.recommendation: Encrypt portable devices like laptops and mobile devices.

recommendations.IT: Use endpoint management tools to enforce disk encryption.
recommendations.Legal: Confirm encryption clauses in BYOD and employee policies.
recommendations.Compliance: Ensure encryption coverage is reported during audits.

recommendations.IT: Deploy and maintain up-to-date antivirus/EDR solutions across all endpoints.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure security requirements are included in vendor agreements.
recommendations.Compliance: Validate antivirus coverage during internal audits.

firewall_enabled.recommendation: Enable firewalls to protect network perimeters.

recommendations.IT: Ensure firewalls are configured with deny-by-default rules.
recommendations.Legal: Review obligations related to perimeter security in SLAs.
recommendations.Compliance: Include firewall reviews in periodic compliance checks.

recommendations.IT: Conduct and document quarterly privilege audits.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure admin access policies are supported by contracts.
recommendations.Compliance: Log review dates and actions in compliance tracker.

system_patches_update_frequency_days.recommendation: Apply critical system patches within 30 days.

recommendations.IT: Track patch management using automated tools.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure SLAs require vendors to patch in under 30 days.
recommendations.Compliance: Monitor patch status during quarterly reviews.

unauthorized_access_monitoring.recommendation: Monitor systems for unauthorized access attempts.

recommendations.IT: Enable SIEM alerts and anomaly detection for access logs.
recommendations.Legal: Review monitoring language in security/privacy policies.
recommendations.Compliance: Ensure alerts are part of audit trail review.

audit_logs_protected_from_modification.recommendation: Protect audit logs from unauthorized changes.

recommendations.IT: Use append-only log storage and WORM drives where possible.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure tamper-evidence policies are documented for regulators.
recommendations.Compliance: Validate log immutability during risk assessments.

recommendations.IT: Schedule realistic simulations and track user clicks.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure no employee rights are violated during simulations.
recommendations.Compliance: Report participation and improvements over time.

external_service_provider_agreements_in_.recommendation: Sign contracts with external vendors regarding data security responsibilities.

recommendations.IT: Review third-party security practices against contract terms.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure DPAs and SLAs include security clauses.
recommendations.Compliance: Maintain a vendor risk register with signed contracts.

encryption_key_management_policy_defined.recommendation: Define a key management policy for encryption keys.

recommendations.IT: Use hardware security modules (HSMs) for key storage.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure policies account for data export controls.
recommendations.Compliance: Include key lifecycle policies in compliance checks.

physical_access_controls_to_data_centers.recommendation: Restrict physical access to data centers to authorized personnel only.

recommendations.IT: Implement badge access, video monitoring, and access logs.
recommendations.Legal: Document controls for client audits or regulators.
recommendations.Compliance: Include physical access checks in annual audits.

environmental_controls_in_data_centers.recommendation: Implement temperature, humidity, and fire controls in server rooms.

recommendations.IT: Ensure HVAC and fire suppression systems are monitored.
recommendations.Legal: Include environmental control responsibilities in facility SLAs.
recommendations.Compliance: Verify system logs during annual assessments.

secure_disposal_of_media.recommendation: Securely dispose of old hard drives and other media containing sensitive data.

recommendations.IT: Use certified destruction services for physical media.
recommendations.Legal: Ensure disposal procedures are contractually defined.
recommendations.Compliance: Track disposal events in audit logs.

privacy_policy_publicly_available.recommendation: Publish a public privacy policy for personal data processing.

recommendations.IT: Ensure the website and applications link to the latest privacy policy.
recommendations.Legal: Draft policy content to meet GDPR transparency standards.
recommendations.Compliance: Review and update annually, track revisions.
